instruction: Use VLC to play the streaming content from: https://bitdash-a.akamaihd.net/content/sintel/hls/playlist.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires streaming Sintel demo video HLS stream in VLC. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric. Same complexity as original task.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing VLC evaluator functions. Sintel is a well-known test video stream.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: checks both VLC playing state and URL match
Getter logic (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status XML from HTTP interface
Metric logic (is_vlc_playing) correctly handles type='rule' parameter - accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] directly without incorrect rule['rules'] access
URL matching logic is robust for HLS streaming with multiple fallback strategies (direct match, filename match for HLS, domain/path comparison)
Expected URL (Sintel HLS stream) is semantically correct and well-known test stream
Complete coverage: verifies both playing state and correct URL
Good edge case handling: multiple XML paths checked, handles HLS streams showing just filename
State accessibility: VLC HTTP interface provides status XML with URL information
